# Parley v0.1.38

**Nothing in the app changed.** This release exists to keep the published
version in step with the repository; the only change is to the test suite,
which is not part of the shipped application. If you are running v0.1.37, this
build behaves identically.

## The test suite no longer litters your Preferences folder

An audit of what Parley's development work writes outside its own project
folder turned up 1,626 stray files in `~/Library/Preferences`, going back to
23 August and totalling 6.4 MB.

They came from one check. It creates an isolated preferences area to verify
that upgrading from an older build does not overwrite settings you have already
chosen, and it named that area with a fresh random identifier on every run.
macOS empties such an area when asked, but leaves the file behind — so every
test run left two more, permanently.

The check now uses a fixed name, so the count stays at two however many times
the suite runs. The files it emptied are also removed directly, though that
alone was not sufficient: measuring showed macOS writes an emptied area back
out shortly afterwards, so a single run appeared clean while a full suite run
still left two behind. Bounding the name is what actually stops the growth.

The 1,626 existing files were removed, each checked as empty beforehand.

## Not addressed here

Container panes keep each vendor's login and conversation history in a Docker
volume, one per pane, and those volumes outlive the panes that created them.
There are currently five, totalling **848 MB**. Removing them is deliberately a
guarded action rather than an automatic one, because they hold real vendor
logins: **Status Center → Health → Containers** performs the ownership checks
and refuses a volume that is still referenced.

That is a far larger item than anything in this release, and it is worth doing
if you use container panes regularly.

## Compatibility

Agent protocol is unchanged at 32, and no pane needs restarting. No stored
state, preference or runtime file changes format.

Validated: 338 native checks and 53 Node tests across three consecutive full
runs, public scan, platform scan and build. The fix was measured by counting
files before and after, with and without the change, rather than inferred.

Unnotarized test beta: ad-hoc signed without the hardened runtime, not
notarized, no automatic updates. Install only from the expected GitLab
release after checking SHA256SUMS.
